items.name: Switch 2 Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition
notes: Nintendo's first special edition Switch 2. Green and gold console, green Joy-Con, and a black dock with a gold Triforce. It's only $20 more than a regular Switch 2, which is a big part of why it went fast.
Preorders sold out at Nintendo, Best Buy and Target within about a day, with resellers asking $800 and up. If you missed it, keep an eye out for restocks before Oct 29.
inTheBox: Dock with black and gold Triforce design
No game. Ocarina of Time is sold separately

timeline.text: Revealed in the Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct. Preorders opened at $519.99.
Reported sold out at Nintendo, Best Buy and Target.

items.name: Switch 2 Pro Controller, Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition
notes: The matching Pro Controller, sold on its own. There's also a version that comes with a display stand. It comes out Oct 29, the same day as the console.

timeline.text: Revealed with the console. Preorders opened at $99.99.
Retailers list Oct 29 as the release date, alongside the console.

items.name: Switch 2 Carrying Case and Screen Protector, Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition
items.searchQuery: Switch 2 Carrying Case Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition
notes: Black carrying case with a gold Triforce and a map of Hyrule, made to match the 40th anniversary console. Comes with a screen protector and a green Zelda cleaning cloth.
The cheapest piece of the set, and it's been easier to find than the console or the Pro Controller.

timeline.text: Revealed with the console and Pro Controller at $39.99.

items.name: Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2), foil first print
notes: Not hardware, but collectors will want it. The first print run of the physical game gets a textured foil cover, and later printings get the regular one. Nintendo Support says preorders placed now are guaranteed the foil version.
Full game on the cartridge, not a game-key card. Digital is $59.99 if you don't care about the box.

items.name: Young Link and Young Zelda amiibo
notes: Kid Link and kid Zelda in their remake designs. Listed on Nintendo's store at $24.99 each. Expected in 2027.

timeline.text: Revealed in the Zelda Direct and listed for preorder.

items.name: LEGO Zelda: Ocarina of Time Link & Epona
notes: 1,750-piece display build of adult Link on a rearing Epona. No minifigures. No price yet. For reference, the 1,003-piece Final Battle set is $130 and the 2,500-piece Deku Tree was $300.

timeline.text: Shown in the Zelda Direct. Spring 2027.

items.name: Xbox Series X25 Limited Edition
notes: Translucent green Series X, styled after the original Xbox, for the 25th anniversary. Every one is numbered with its own engraving. $100 over a standard 1TB Series X, but it comes with the matching controller and Halo: Campaign Evolved.
Limit one per customer. One outlet listed Oct 20 as the release date, but that's the controller. The console is Nov 13.
inTheBox: Translucent green 1TB Series X, individually numbered

timeline.text: Early preorder invites emailed to some fans.

items.name: Xbox X25 Special Edition Controller
notes: The translucent green controller from the X25 set, on its own. Comes out about three weeks before the console.

items.name: Razer Xbox 25th Anniversary Collection
notes: Translucent green versions of three existing Razer products. Razer's US store lists the keyboard at $209.99, the mouse at $179.99 and the earbuds at $119.99, shipping Oct 20. Some early coverage had lower prices, so go by Razer's site.
Same hardware as the regular versions, so you're paying for the look.
inTheBox: BlackWidow V4 75% keyboard (with anniversary wrist rest)

items.name: 8BitDo X25 Special Edition Charging Dock
notes: Translucent green version of 8BitDo's Ultimate Charging Dock for Xbox controllers, part of the 25th anniversary accessory lineup.

items.name: GameSir X5 Lite, Xbox 25th Anniversary
notes: Phone controller in the anniversary green. Cheapest way into the X25 look.

items.name: ROG Xbox Ally X20
notes: ASUS's 20th anniversary version of the Xbox Ally X. Translucent black shell with gold inside, and a 7.4" OLED screen, which is the real upgrade. Same chip as the Ally X, so it's not any faster.
$300 more than the Ally X. There's also a $2,499.99 bundle with XREAL AR glasses, a dbrand case and a Pelican case.

timeline.text: Price confirmed at Gamescom and preorders opened.

items.name: DualSense GTA VI White Limited Edition
items.searchQuery: DualSense Grand Theft Auto VI White Limited Edition
notes: The "daytime" Vice City controller. Color-shifting finish and palm trees molded into the grips. Ships the day GTA VI comes out. This one is sold at regular stores too, not just PlayStation Direct.

items.name: DualSense GTA VI Black Limited Edition
items.searchQuery: DualSense Grand Theft Auto VI Black Limited Edition
notes: The "nightlife" version. Same finish and grips as the white one, but in the US it's only sold through PlayStation Direct, so it's the harder one to get.

items.name: PS5 GTA VI console bundle
notes: People have expected a GTA VI PS5 bundle since a 2023 leak, and Sony has been pushing the PS5 Pro version of the game. So far the two controllers are the only official GTA VI hardware.
If one gets announced before Nov 19, expect it to go fast.

timeline.text: Controllers went up for preorder, still no console bundle.

items.name: PS5 Wolverine Battle Yellow Bundle
notes: Yellow and black PS5 Digital with claw marks cut into it, plus a matching controller and the game. Matching console covers are $74.99 on PlayStation Direct.

items.name: DualSense Wolverine Limited Editions
notes: Two designs: Battle Yellow, and Adamantium, which is metallic silver with see-through claw marks.

items.name: DualSense Lisa Limited Edition
items.searchQuery: Lisa limited edition DualSense PS5 controller
notes: Made with Lisa from BLACKPINK. Chroma Pearl finish with her eyes and bangs on the touchpad, plus stars and an "LL" monogram. It's part of a wider Lisa x PlayStation merch line.
Sony says stock will be very limited, so expect it to go fast.

timeline.text: Preorders opened at PlayStation Direct and other stores.

items.name: LEGO PlayStation (72306)
notes: A 1,911-piece LEGO build of the original PlayStation and its controller, with a working disc lid and hidden Gran Turismo and Ape Escape scenes inside.
LEGO Insiders could buy it from Oct 1, and it's open to everyone from Oct 4. PlayStation Direct is adding a free Astro Bot set with orders.
inTheBox: Astro Bot mini set (PlayStation Direct orders only)

items.name: Sonic 35th Anniversary Porcelain Statue
notes: Made in Japan by two porcelain kilns working together.
Only 50 will be made.
I don't know yet how sales will work or when it ships.

items.name: Xbox Controller, Gears of War: E-Day Limited Edition
items.searchQuery: Gears of War E-Day Limited Edition Xbox Wireless Controller
notes: Cracked-looking shell with the Crimson Omen showing through, transparent red buttons and a metal COG tag.
There's also a Design Lab version with heavy metal art by Luke Preece, if you'd rather build your own.

items.name: THEC64 and The Spectrum Handheld Collector's Editions
notes: Clamshell handhelds styled after the Commodore 64 and the ZX Spectrum, each with 25 built-in games and a microSD slot for your own.

The Collector's Editions are limited to 2,000 each and only sold through Funstock. They add a hard travel case and an exclusive magazine (Zzap!64 for the C64, Crash for the Spectrum). The standard versions are $129.99.
They were due Oct 15, but Blaze pushed both to April 22, 2027 to fix build quality issues.

timeline.text: Delayed from Oct 15 to April 22, 2027 over build quality.

items.name: Sonic 1 & 2 35th Anniversary Legacy Cartridges (Genesis)
notes: Real Genesis cartridges of Sonic the Hedgehog and Sonic 2 from iam8bit that play on an original NTSC Genesis. Sonic 1 comes in a translucent blue shell and Sonic 2 in orange.
One in eight comes in a special "Chaos Emerald" shell. Orders ship in waves, starting in Q3 2026 and running into Q1 2027, so order early if you want one soon.

items.name: Zelda: Majora's Mask remake (Switch 2)
notes: Nothing official. The rumor comes from an IMDb credit for Nobuyuki Hiyama, who voices adult Link in the Ocarina remake, and anyone can edit IMDb.
The pattern fits, though: on 3DS, Ocarina of Time 3D was followed by Majora's Mask 3D. If it gets announced, I'd expect a special edition to come with it.

items.name: Electric Ocarina of Time (HORI)
items.searchQuery: HORI Electric Ocarina of Time Switch 2
notes: A real, playable ocarina from HORI, licensed by Nintendo, that works with the Ocarina of Time remake. Free Play mode lets you play notes yourself, and Auto-Play plays any of the game's 12 songs at the press of a button.
It comes out the same day as the game. The first batch at My Nintendo Store sold out within minutes of preorders opening, so watch for restocks.

timeline.text: Preorders opened at My Nintendo Store at $49.99 and sold out quickly.

items.name: GTA VI: The Goodtime State Vice City Collection
items.searchQuery: GTA VI Goodtime State Vice City Collection
notes: Rockstar's collector's box for GTA VI, themed around Macca the Gator, a TV show in the game. It's all merch: the game itself isn't included, so you'll need to buy that separately.
Only sold through the Rockstar Store, while supplies last. Arrives Nov 19, the day GTA VI comes out.
inTheBox: Vice City swizzle spoon and razor blade keychain
Enamel pin set, sticker pack, and a double-sided poster with a map of Leonida

timeline.text: Revealed at $399.99, with preorders open on the Rockstar Store.

items.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation Collector's Edition
items.searchQuery: Final Fantasy VII Revelation Collector's Edition
notes: The final part of the Final Fantasy VII remake trilogy. The Collector's Edition centers on a statue of Cloud, Zack and Sephiroth, and includes the physical Deluxe Edition and the Story Expansion Pass.
Limited quantities, sold only through the Square Enix Store, and it sold out within days. Square Enix says there are no plans to restock.
inTheBox: Story Expansion Pass (two story DLCs planned)

timeline.text: Sold out on the Square Enix Store, with no restock planned.

items.name: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Collector's Edition
items.searchQuery: Star Wars Galactic Racer Collector's Edition
notes: Comes with a metal model of Kor Sarun's Darc X landspeeder, plus the game in a steel case and all the digital Deluxe content.
Reported sold out, with resale listings around $230.
inTheBox: Full game in a steel case

items.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced Collector's Edition
items.searchQuery: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced Collector's Edition
notes: The remake of Black Flag, with a 12-inch statue of Edward Kenway on the deck of the Jackdaw as the centerpiece.
inTheBox: SteelBook, cloth world map and sea shanty sheet

items.name: Metro 2039 Collector's Edition
notes: The centerpiece is a replica of the Stranger's battle-scarred Spartan helmet, built from the in-game model. It's the only confirmed item so far.
Deep Silver hasn't announced the price, the full contents or where to buy it. Preorders are due later this year.

timeline.text: Revealed at Gamescom with the Spartan helmet.
